pluss::subsp::stats::ts::GjrOptions¶

Options of ts::Gjr::fit_mle.

GjrOptions sets the model orders where they exist, the starting values and the search settings.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

arch_order

std::int64_t

1

Number of lagged squared shocks.

garch_order

std::int64_t

1

Number of lagged variances.

omega0

double

0.02

Starting value of the constant.

arch0

std::vector<double>

{0.08}

Starting values of the shock coefficients.

asym0

std::vector<double>

{0.04}

Starting values of the extra coefficients on negative shocks (kept non-negative).

garch0

std::vector<double>

{0.86}

Starting values of the variance coefficients.

demean

bool

true

Subtract the sample mean first (held fixed during the search); with false the mean is zero.

variance_floor

double

1e-12

Smallest conditional variance the recursion allows.

stationarity_margin

double

1e-6

How far inside the stationarity boundary the persistence must stay.

finite_diff_eps

double

1e-5

Step of the numerical derivatives used by score and observed_inf.

max_iterations, max_evaluations

std::int64_t

800, 6000

Limits of the Nelder–Mead search.

simplex_delta

double

0.05

Relative size of the initial simplex.

nm_restarts

std::int64_t

3

Number of restarts of the search from perturbed points; the best result is kept.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
